personalStats.title: Personalized suggestions
personalStats.description: Link your Windrun.io profile to blend your personal ability and hero winrates into the overlay's suggestions. Abilities you historically win with rank higher; your stats also show in ability tooltips.
personalStats.inputPlaceholder: Windrun profile URL or Steam ID
personalStats.inputHint: Paste your Windrun profile link (windrun.io/players/…), your Steam ID64, or your Friend ID.
personalStats.refreshSuccess: Refreshed: {{abilities}} abilities, {{heroes}} heroes with personal stats.
personalStats.blendNote: Personal winrates are blended with global stats in proportion to how many games you have on each ability — small samples only nudge the score. Stats refresh automatically when the overlay is activated (at most once per hour).
personalStats.scrapeHint: Your local Windrun data predates ability matching — run 'Update Windrun Data' on the Data page once to activate ability personalization.
personalStats.errorInvalidInput: Could not read a player ID from that input. Paste a windrun.io profile link or a Steam ID.
personalStats.errorProfileNotFound: Windrun.io returned no profile for that ID. Check the link and your connection.
personalStats.errorFetchFailed: Fetching stats from Windrun.io failed. Your previous stats are kept — try again later.

autoTracking.title: Automatic draft tracking
autoTracking.description: Automates the whole draft flow: the initial pool scan, your spot and hero model selection, and targeted rescans after every pick with per-player pick tracking.
autoTracking.gsiNote: This feature relies on Dota 2's built-in Game State Integration (GSI). With the config file installed, your game sends draft information (game phase, draft clock, your slot and picked hero) to this app. The connection is local-only and strictly one-way — the app never sends anything to the game and nothing leaves your PC. GSI is an official Valve feature used by broadcast tools and carries no ban risk.
autoTracking.delayHint: How long to wait after the draft is detected before scanning the pool automatically ({{min}}–{{max}}s). Fast PCs are fine with 5s; slower machines may need up to 30s for the draft screen to fully render.
autoTracking.buttonsNote: While enabled, the manual My Spot and My Model overlay buttons are hidden — both selections happen automatically from game data.
autoTracking.setupHint: One-time: install the config file below into your Dota folder, then restart Dota 2.
